steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Ensure post-expiry surrogate bidding is disabled.
Enable buyer bid-field editing as required.
Keep evaluation reopening restricted as required.
Click horizontal-switch and record what opens, changes, or remains unchanged.
Assert that the control leaves the buyer on the Responses screen, matching the expected lack of visible navigation change.
